{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Drop refunded orders
refunded_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
df_clean = df_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Filter for converted orders
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1].copy()

# Compute average revenue per converted order within each customer_segment
stratified_avg = df_final.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute within-segment differences
within_segment_diff = stratified_avg['email'] - stratified_avg['paid_search']

# Print the within-segment differences
print("Within-segment differences (email - paid_search):")
print(within_segment_diff)

# Compute overall average revenue by channel
overall_avg = df_final.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Compute the overall difference
overall_diff = overall_avg['email'] - overall_avg['paid_search']

# Print the overall difference
print(f"\nOverall difference (email - paid_search): {overall_diff:.2f}")"}
